about: The Leyline Discord, upgraded (docs/DISCORD-PLAN.md, 1 Nov). Opt in with WU_DISCORD_TEMPLATE=/app/discord_template_v2.json in portal.env; then HQ > Content > Discord > Preview, and Set up the Discord makes what is missing, found by exact name. Channel names carry the 30 Oct emoji and bar (👋︱welcome), the same as tools/discord-leyline/discord_leyline.py LAYOUT (a test checks they agree). It never deletes, renames, moves or changes anything already there: moving old channels is the owner's by-hand list in the plan.
